name: AM-694
summary: AM-694 (1-(5-fluoropentyl)-3-(2-iodobenzoyl)indole) is a designer drug that acts as a potent and selective agonist for the cannabinoid receptor CB1. It is used in scientific research for mapping the distribution of CB1 receptors.

pharmacology.text: AM-694 is an agonist for cannabinoid receptors. It has a Ki of 0.08 nM at CB1 and 18 times selectivity over CB2 with a Ki of 1.44 nM. It is unclear what is responsible for this unusually high CB1 binding affinity, but it makes the 18F radiolabelled derivative of AM-694 useful for mapping the distribution of CB1 receptors in the body.

uses.text: AM-694 (1-(5-fluoropentyl)-3-(2-iodobenzoyl)indole) is a designer drug that acts as a potent and selective agonist for the cannabinoid receptor CB1. It is used in scientific research for mapping the distribution of CB1 receptors.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, agitation, vomiting, confusion, seizures and psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。同類的合成大麻素可能造成心跳急促、躁動、嘔吐、混亂、癲癇發作與精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。同类的合成大麻素可能造成心跳急促、躁动、呕吐、混乱、癫痫发作与精神病。

fact.en: It binds the CB1 receptor remarkably tightly, and chemists still cannot fully explain why. Nobody expected a simple iodine atom to do so much, and it is used in the laboratory to map CB1 receptors.
fact.zh: 它與 CB1 受體的結合異常緊密，化學家至今仍無法完全解釋原因。沒有人預期一個簡單的碘原子能造成這麼大的差異，它被用於實驗室繪製 CB1 受體分布圖。
fact.zhHans: 它与 CB1 受体的结合异常紧密，化学家至今仍无法完全解释原因。没有人预期一个简单的碘原子能造成这么大的差异，它被用于实验室绘制 CB1 受体分布图。
